claude_proposed_widenings.name: ReactionTrigger.hit_by_attack_roll.weaponFilter.thrown_or_ranged
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing reaction trigger can narrow by weapon category, but it cannot express the SRD trigger's mixed "Ranged or Thrown weapon" set honestly. "Thrown" is not equivalent to the existing melee/ranged category split.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If you're hit by an attack roll made with a Ranged or Thrown weapon

claude_proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.free_hand
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The triggered-reaction magic-item family already supports gating by equipment state, but there is no way to require an available free hand as part of the reaction's legality.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can take a Reaction to reduce the damage by 1d10 plus your Dexterity modifier if you have a free hand
